text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun opening a class defined by the following denial clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ladhīna}}) opens by making a human class out of the following denial clause, so the verdict begins with classification rather than narration. Its definite plural relative form is answered by the second {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ladhīna}}) at word 8, letting the ayah compare two formally matched groups before their outcomes diverge. The prior warning about Satan's intended destination now becomes explicit allotment: the class defined by denial receives the named liability.

topics.headline: definite relative class before outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first classifies people by a following act before naming any consequence.
topics.reason: The QAC and clause evidence identify word 1 as a fronted relative topic whose ṣilah is the following perfect verb.

topics.headline: first relative anticipates matched counterpart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first class is built in a form that will be repeated for the second class.
topics.reason: The second relative pronoun at word 8 is coordinated with word 1, so the repetition is structurally local.

topics.headline: prior warning becomes allocated verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from the prior warning into explicit distribution of outcomes.
topics.reason: The boundary row supplies discourse continuity; no guardrail contradicts the transition from warning to verdict.

words.gloss_range: objectless Form I perfect denial/refusal as a settled group orientation, with covering-denial pressure kept local
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denying, rejecting, or ingratitude branches; here objectless Form I selects blameworthy denial as class-defining conduct

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: protective forgiveness that reverses blameworthy covering

words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) is a Form I perfect plural with no stated object, so denial is heard as a settled orientation rather than as refusal of one specified item. The covering-denial field remains concrete: it will be morally reversed by {{ar:مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:maghfiratun}}), where covering protects fault instead of concealing truth. The single verb also makes the negative ṣilah compressed, and its immediate pairing with punishment enters a denial-punishment verdict field later expanded in the same surah (35:36), while the opposing positive class will require faith joined to work.

topics.headline: objectless perfect generalizes denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is not restricted to one named object but becomes the group's defining posture.
topics.reason: The verb instance has no explicit object, and the relative clause uses the verb as the classifying predicate.

topics.headline: covering denial reversed by forgiveness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one physical image of covering split into culpable concealment and protective pardon.
topics.reason: The local ayah includes both the denial root and the forgiveness root, so the polarity of covering is locally anchored.

topics.headline: direct Form I group conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the denial as the group's own completed act, bound back to the relative pronoun.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form I perfect 3mp verb, supporting direct completed group conduct rather than causative mediation.

topics.headline: denial opposed to faith and punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb entering a known denial-punishment field while standing slot-for-slot against faith.
topics.reason: The local clause immediately assigns punishment to the denial group, and the second half supplies the opposing faith verb.

words.gloss_range: fronted allocative lām forming liability-for-them before the punishment noun arrives

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: repeated allocative lām with opposite positive payload
punishment noun in the first allocation

words.prose: The first {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) fronts the allocation frame before {{ar:عَذَابٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) is named, so liability is attached to the deniers first and the penalty arrives as the delayed payload. Its range of possession, allocation, benefit, and liability is locally pushed toward liability by the punishment noun. Because the same frame returns at word 13 with benefit, the grammar becomes a scale for opposite outcomes.

topics.headline: fronted lām assigns liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is marked as recipient of liability before the punishment noun appears.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the lām-pronoun phrase as the fronted predicate for the punishment noun.

topics.headline: allocation range narrowed by punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same allocative particle can carry liability here because its payload is punishment.
topics.reason: The preposition's broad allocation range survives, but the local delayed noun forces the liability side.

topics.headline: same frame returns with opposite payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both destinies being weighed by the same fronted lām-pronoun template.
topics.reason: The second lām-pronoun frame repeats the first while changing the payload from punishment to forgiveness and reward.

words.gloss_range: third masculine plural pronoun governed by the first lām and resuming the denial class as recipient of liability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first lām-pronoun allocation unit

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) resumes the class defined by denial inside the fronted {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) unit. The pronoun is not a new topic; it is governed by the lām and turns the described group into the recipient of the coming consequence. Its compact plural form keeps the allocation personal and collective without repeating the whole relative clause.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes denial class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the described deniers being converted into recipients of consequence by a compact pronoun.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence identifies the pronoun as resuming the preceding relative group.

topics.headline: pronoun governed inside lām frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recipienthood is grammatically fixed before the punishment noun arrives.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the pronoun as governed by the prefixed lām in the fronted predicate phrase.

topics.headline: full plural form matched later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same compact pronoun shape supporting symmetry between the two allocation frames.
topics.reason: Word 14 repeats the plural pronoun for the second group, preserving formal comparison.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative punishment noun as delayed subject in the first allocation, locally narrowed to severe penal suffering
words.root_gloss_range: range includes sweetness/freshness and punitive suffering; the local noun with severe adjective selects punishment while retaining deprivation-pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: severe adjective bound to the punishment noun
the two positive outcome nouns contrasted with the single punishment noun

words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) arrives after the recipient frame as the delayed nominative payload, making punishment an assigned state rather than a narrated act. Its indefiniteness leaves scope open until {{ar:شَدِيدٌۭ}} ({{tr:shadīdun}}) binds severity directly to it as a familiar severe-punishment formula also heard within this surah (35:10). The root field has a sweetness/pain tension, but the local punishment noun and severe modifier select painful penal consequence; across the ayah it stands as the single negative outcome against the doubled positive allocation.

topics.headline: delayed indefinite punishment subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment as an assigned standing reality after recipienthood has been fixed.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify an indefinite nominative noun delayed after the fronted lām phrase.

topics.headline: punishment bound to severe adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices severity attaching specifically to the punishment noun through a familiar penal phrase.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the noun locally, and the supplied cooccurrence rows support the severe-punishment formula.

topics.headline: punitive sense selected from wider root field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the painful allotment as a deprivation-laden reversal of the root's pleasant pole.
topics.reason: The wider root field includes pleasant sweetness, but local morphology and the severe adjective select punishment, so the pleasant pole survives only as contrastive pressure.

topics.headline: single negative outcome against expanded positive side
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one severe punishment is later answered by forgiveness plus reward, not by a simple inverse noun.
topics.reason: The ayah's second allocation has two positive nouns, and the punishment noun recurs in same-surah and cross-surah penal registers.

words.gloss_range: qualitative adjective making the punishment tight, forceful, and severe without comparison
words.root_gloss_range: tightening, strengthening, binding, intensifying, severity; here adjective agreement selects constrictive penal severity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final adjective of magnitude for the reward
punishment noun in the first allocation

words.prose: {{ar:شَدِيدٌۭ}} ({{tr:shadīdun}}) agrees with {{ar:عَذَابٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) and closes the first outcome by tightening the punishment already assigned. The root's binding and intensifying field makes severity feel like pressure with no slack, while the simple qualitative adjective avoids comparison. Its position before the pivot leaves the first half ending in constriction, later answered by the different scale of {{ar:كَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:kabīrun}}).

topics.headline: severity fixed to punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that severity modifies the punishment itself, not the whole scene as a loose mood.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the adjective relation with agreement in case, gender, and indefiniteness.

topics.headline: tightness image becomes penal severity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices severity as constrictive pressure rather than neutral strength.
topics.reason: The broader root includes tightening and strength, while the punishment noun selects the penal severity branch.

topics.headline: inherent severity without comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the punishment described as severe in itself, not measured against the reward.
topics.reason: The surface is a simple qualitative adjective, not a comparative form.

topics.headline: negative half closes in pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah balancing adjective closures while contrasting pressure with abundance.
topics.reason: This adjective completes the first clause before the central conjunction, and the final adjective later answers it.

words.gloss_range: central conjunction joining the two full outcome blocks while functioning as the ayah's contrastive pivot

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: repeated relative pronoun opening each class

words.prose: The central {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the pivot between two complete allocation blocks. It joins the halves while preventing the second {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ladhīna}}) from being read as another descriptor of the punished group. Because it comes after a completed severe-punishment phrase, the conjunction turns simple coordination into moral contrast and opens the expanded positive frame.

topics.headline: two full outcome complexes coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle links whole judgment blocks, not merely adjacent words.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the second relative group as conjoined with the first relative group across full clauses.

topics.headline: central pivot into counter-class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turn from a completed penalty block to a matched but expanded benefit block.
topics.reason: The conjunction stands between completed negative allocation and the second relative opening, creating local contrast.

topics.headline: warning becomes two-sided verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse widening from warning into a distributed two-sided judgment.
topics.reason: The boundary row is coherent with the ayah's shift into paired allocations.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: faith/trust verb beginning the positive predicate

words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ladhīna}}) restarts the classification with the same relative form as word 1, preserving a direct comparison between two complete groups. Its ṣilah expands into {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) plus {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}), so the positive identity is richer inside the same grammatical template. That interaction lets symmetry appear first and asymmetry unfold through the predicates.

topics.headline: new matched relative class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second group introduced at the same formal level as the first, not as a mere pronoun replacement.
topics.reason: Word 8 is a second masculine plural relative pronoun coordinated with word 1.

topics.headline: one relative governs faith plus work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one positive class is defined by trust joined to action before benefit is named.
topics.reason: The local clause evidence shows the faith verb and coordinated work verb under the second relative construction.

topics.headline: identical opening with richer predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the positive side expanding only after the same relative frame has restored comparison.
topics.reason: The repeated relative opening is identical, while the following predicates differ in length and content.

words.gloss_range: objectless Form IV perfect belief/trust as settled positive orientation that continues into work
words.root_gloss_range: safety, trust, security, reliability, belief, confirmation; here Form IV selects committed faith/trust rather than a bare state of safety

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: performed work that continues the faith predicate
conjunction linking faith to work

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) is a Form IV perfect plural with no explicit object, so the positive class begins with broad committed trust rather than a narrow assent to one stated item. The safety and reliability field makes faith a secure relation, but the immediate {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the ṣilah open until work follows. In the mirrored syntax it stands opposite {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}), so trust reverses covering-denial and becomes the first half of the familiar faith-work formula.

topics.headline: broad objectless faith relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices belief as a broad defining relation, not as assent narrowed to a named object in this clause.
topics.reason: The verb instance has no explicit object, and the following coordination supplies enacted completion rather than an object.

topics.headline: safety field selected as committed faith

topics.reason: The root field includes safety and trust, while coordination with work selects committed faith rather than an isolated safety state.

topics.headline: Form IV relational movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith expressed as a derived relational act, not merely the base state of being safe.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as Form IV perfect 3mp, and the rows press the contrast with the base safety-state form.

topics.headline: faith begins formula and opposes denial

topics.reason: The verb stands in the second relative predicate slot, is immediately coordinated with work, and belongs to the recurrent faith-work phrase.

words.prose: This internal {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) to {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) under one relative head. Its scope is inside the positive ṣilah, unlike the central pivot at word 7, so action becomes co-defining rather than a new class or optional sequel. The attached form lengthens only the believer side before any benefit is assigned.

topics.headline: work joined to faith under one subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices action being grammatically tied to faith as part of the same identity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the work verb as conjoined with the faith verb inside the second relative construction.

topics.headline: internal wāw differs from central pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that only the believer ṣilah expands internally, making the positive identity syntactically fuller.
topics.reason: Word 10 coordinates predicates within the second relative clause, while word 7 coordinates the two larger blocks.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect performed work, transitive here because the recognized sound deeds fill its object slot
words.root_gloss_range: doing, working, producing, practicing, dealing; here direct performed work is morally specified by its object

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) turns the positive ṣilah from inward trust into performed action, and its explicit object {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāt}}) keeps the work from becoming morally generic. The Form I perfect plural keeps agency with the same believers who trusted. Because {{ar:أَجْرٌۭ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}) follows later, the root's work and service field prepares the reward as recompense for enacted sound deeds.

topics.headline: work takes sound-deeds object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the work is not generic activity but performed sound deeds.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks word 12 as the direct object of the work verb.

topics.headline: same group enacts work after faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices trust becoming visible practice by the same plural subject.
topics.reason: The 3mp verb shares the relative-clause subject with the preceding faith verb.

topics.headline: purposeful labor prepares reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the later reward as value returned to performed work, not a vague prize.
topics.reason: The work root is locally followed by the reward noun, and the supplied rows press the recompense field.

topics.headline: direct Form I work expands positive identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the positive identity becoming more than simple opposition to denial by adding direct performed conduct.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form I perfect, and the first half has only one predicate while this half adds work.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine plural active-participle noun naming recognized sound/restorative deeds as the object of work

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāt}}) completes the work verb as a definite plural object: the deeds are recognized, manifold acts of soundness rather than vague goodness. The root's repair and reconciliation field makes righteousness feel restorative, as work that sets things right. By sealing the positive ṣilah before the second {{ar:لَهُم}} ({{tr:lahum}}), the word makes reward follow a fully specified faith-work identity.

topics.headline: recognized sound deeds as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object specifies a known class of deeds, not an undefined moral mood.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as direct object, and QAC identifies it as a definite feminine plural active-participle noun.

topics.headline: righteous deeds as restorative soundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices righteous deeds as acts of repair and fitness, not generic niceness.
topics.reason: The broader root covers repair, soundness, and righteousness; the local object selects deeds bearing that restorative quality.

topics.headline: sound deeds linked to faith and reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sound deeds as the bridge between faith and recompense.
topics.reason: The local phrase is the recurrent faith-work formula, and reward follows in the outcome clause.

topics.headline: object seals ṣilah before allocation

topics.reason: The object closes the coordinated work phrase before the second lām-pronoun allocation begins.

words.prose: The second {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) repeats the fronted allocation grammar, but its payload is now {{ar:مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:maghfiratun}}) and {{ar:أَجْرٌۭ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}). One lām-pronoun frame governs both positive nouns, so the beneficiary is established once and the benefit can expand. The repeated form makes the reversal precise: the same grammar that carried liability now distributes benefit.

topics.headline: positive frame repeats negative template

Its compact repetition of the earlier pronoun preserves the matched allocation frame while the positive payload grows.

words.prose: {{ar:مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:maghfiratun}}) is the first positive delayed subject after {{ar:لَهُم}} ({{tr:lahum}}), so remission is allocated before recompense is added. Its protective covering image reverses {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}): one covering conceals truth, the other shields fault. As an indefinite maṣdar, forgiveness is presented as a granted state rather than a narrated request, and the nasal join from the pronoun into the mīm makes this first benefit feel attached to the recipient frame. The following {{ar:وَأَجْرٌۭ}} ({{tr:wa-ajrun}}) turns pardon into the first member of an accumulating reward pair echoed in the supplied reward formula (11:11; 67:12).

topics.headline: forgiveness covers fault protectively

topics.reason: The local ayah contains the denial root and the forgiveness root, and the rows press their shared covering image with opposite valence.

It is not a new temporal step; it accumulates a second co-present benefit and makes the believer outcome exceed a simple reversal of punishment. The attached form in {{ar:وَأَجْرٌۭ}} ({{tr:wa-ajrun}}) keeps reward grammatically joined while giving it a distinct onset.

words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرٌۭ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}) is the second positive noun, coordinated with forgiveness under the same beneficiary frame but taking {{ar:كَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:kabīrun}}) as its own modifier. After {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}), its wage/recompense field is especially active: the ayah moves from protective remission to honored return for sound work. The singular indefinite noun gathers recompense into one open category rather than itemized wages, and the closing formula ties local reward to the broader {{ar:أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:ajrun kabīr}}) expression (11:11; 67:12).

words.prose: {{ar:كَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:kabīrun}}) agrees with {{ar:أَجْرٌۭ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}), so the final greatness lands on recompense specifically rather than spreading across the whole benefit pair. The root's size and weight field becomes value and consequence here, while arrogance or self-magnification branches are excluded by the reward syntax. As the ayah's final word, it answers the earlier {{ar:شَدِيدٌۭ}} ({{tr:shadīdun}}) not with more pressure but with magnitude; it also completes the supplied reward-pair formula (11:11; 67:12), and the three-beat positive cadence closes fuller than the first half's two indefinite beats.

topics.headline: greatness modifies reward alone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices final greatness attaching specifically to reward, not to forgiveness and reward as an undifferentiated pair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the adjective relation to reward with matching masculine nominative indefiniteness.

topics.headline: weight and size become reward value
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reward made spacious and consequential without importing arrogance or burden.
topics.reason: The broad root includes magnitude, rank, seriousness, and self-magnification; the local adjective modifying reward selects legitimate value and scale.

topics.headline: intrinsic greatness closes the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's last semantic impression as unstated but intrinsic magnitude of reward.
topics.reason: The form is a simple qualitative adjective in final position, not a comparative or verbal magnification.

topics.headline: positive closure answers severe closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing with a known great-reward formula and a fuller cadence than the punishment half.
topics.reason: The final adjective completes the forgiveness-reward formula, bookends the earlier severe adjective, and contributes to the repeated indefinite cadence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired alladhina...lahum clauses, with one initiating act and one outcome on the first side but faith plus work and two outcomes on the second.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse distributes consequences asymmetrically: truth-blocking meets punitive pain, whereas settled assent must issue in intended repair and receives both protection from prior fault and positive recompense.

activation_trace.role: Supplies deliberate obstruction of truth as the negative side's initiating act.
Supplies punitive pain as the direct negative allocation.
Supplies heart-settling assent as the positive side's inward commitment.
Supplies intentional doing, making the positive side more than assent.
Supplies repair against corruption as the quality of the doing.
Supplies protection from a fault's consequence, functioning as deficit removal.
Supplies a return for work, functioning as positive recompense.
Supplies magnitude to the recompense rather than merely balancing the deficit.

changed_reading.before: A flat binary in which disbelief gets punishment and belief gets reward.
changed_reading.after: An asymmetric account: blocking truth yields one severe liability, while trusted truth embodied as repair receives both release from liability and an enlarged positive return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots of kafaru and maghfirah both activate materially different kinds of covering inside the two parallel clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The moral contrast is not simply concealment versus exposure. One side actively covers truth or gift; the other receives a cover that shields the person from the continuing effect of fault. Direction and beneficiary distinguish suppressive covering from protective counter-covering.

activation_trace.role: Supplies agentive covering as the material substrate of the negative act.
Narrows that covering toward suppression of a received good.
Supplies a preserving cover on the positive side.
Turns the preserving cover into protection from a fault's damaging sequel.
Supplies safety and trust as the state produced by protective covering.

changed_reading.before: Denial and forgiveness are unrelated legal labels on opposite sides.
changed_reading.after: The clauses stage rival coverings: a person suppresses what should be acknowledged, or is protectively covered after trusting and repairing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The positive sequence joins amanu directly to amilu al-salihat before assigning maghfirah and ajr.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled inward trust becomes visible as intentional work whose test is repair, reconciliation, or fitness. The sequence is a movement from inward security to outward restoration, not two unrelated credentials.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inward safety and confidence as the starting condition.
Supplies purposive enactment as the bridge from inward state to world.
Supplies removal of estrangement as one social function of the deeds.
Supplies fit and appropriateness as another test of the deeds.
Supplies a consequential return to work that actually performs those functions.

changed_reading.before: Faith and righteous deeds are two checklist qualifications.
changed_reading.after: Faith is a secured orientation that must take reparative, reconciling, and fitting form in deliberate action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The outcome adjectives shadid and kabir flank roots that can image withholding, binding, covering, and measured return.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negative result contracts: access is withheld and the condition is tightened. The positive result first shelters and then expands into a return of large scope. The adjectives supply opposing material vectors rather than generic emphasis alone.

activation_trace.role: Supplies withholding or forced abstention as a possible material contour of punishment.
Supplies tightening and binding as the negative result's constrictive force.
Supplies shelter as the first positive movement away from constriction.
Supplies measured return as the positive substance being enlarged.
Supplies expansion of scale as the positive result's counter-vector.

changed_reading.before: Severe and great are interchangeable intensifiers attached to opposite outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The outcomes have contrary shapes: punitive tightening and deprivation versus protective covering followed by enlarged return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opened mercy and remembered provision are followed by directional reversal, a fixed true promise, glittering deception, and an enemy call that gathers a party toward ignition. Kufr and iman become rival responses to gift and promise, with social recruitment carrying each response toward its destination.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an opened access through which mercy becomes available.
Supplies tender mercy as the gift to which the two orientations respond.
Supplies experienced good condition as something that can be remembered or covered.
Supplies directional turning as the transition from received gift to denial.
Supplies a promise fixed to reality as the secure object of trust.
Supplies deceptive surface appeal that fails to hold, competing with the true promise.
Supplies a verbal call that inclines hearers toward an outcome.
Supplies collective alignment around a shared orientation, making the mechanism social.
Supplies ignition as the recruited party's stated destination.

structural_cues: 35:2-6 moves in order from opened mercy and provision through promise and deception to an enemy call, a gathered party, and fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gifts, reversal, deception, recruitment, and destination; I infer a causal path from misread gift to covered truth and collective arrival. Alternatively, the sequence may frame the verdict without specifying the psychology of either class.

changed_reading.before: The two classes in 35:7 are static labels presented without formation history.
changed_reading.after: They are formed by rival calls: trust receives gift and true promise, while deceptive reversal recruits denial into a collective path toward fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bad work can be cosmetically improved and then perceived as good. Work, appearance, and actual salih quality therefore separate: the focus verse cannot let the actor's favorable self-perception certify the deed.

activation_trace.role: Supplies active beautification that changes an act's appearance without changing its kind.
Supplies objective badness beneath the improved appearance.
Repeats intentional work, directly placing the focus term inside the deception mechanism.
Supplies perception as the fallible point at which decorated work is judged.
Supplies the positive appearance mistakenly assigned to the bad work.
Supplies departure from right direction as the larger epistemic condition.
Supplies gentle direction toward truth as the contrasting criterion.

structural_cues: 35:8 places bad work, seeing, and good appearance in one causal clause before contrasting misdirection and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bad act made to look good and opposing directional states; I infer that salih in 35:7 names genuine repair rather than self-certified attractiveness. Alternatively, 35:8 may diagnose one opponent group without defining every salih act.

changed_reading.before: Righteous works are transparently recognizable to the person performing them.
changed_reading.after: A performer can admire a corrupted work, so salih must be tested by real repair, fit, and truthful direction rather than felt or displayed goodness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good speech ascends and salih work participates in raising it, while the opposing practice ends in barrenness. The positive pair in 35:7 is dynamic: enacted repair gives truthful speech lift, efficacy, or embodied credibility.

activation_trace.role: Supplies upward movement for the good word.
Supplies intelligible speech as what enters the vertical mechanism.
Supplies a quality opposed to corruption for the ascending speech.
Repeats intentional work as an active component of the lift.
Repeats repair against corruption as the work's operative quality.
Supplies the raising relation that joins word and work.
Supplies perishing corruption as the terminal contrast to successful ascent.

structural_cues: The salih work immediately precedes yarfa'uhu in 35:10; the pronoun relation remains grammatically live, and the verse later repeats 35:7's severe punishment for the opposite practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ascent, good speech, salih work, raising, and perishing; I infer that enactment gives speech effective lift. A materially live alternative is that God raises the work, or that the work itself is what rises, rather than work raising speech.

changed_reading.before: Faith and works are cumulative qualifications that independently earn the stated outcomes.
changed_reading.after: Trusted good speech and salih action form a lift system: action may carry, validate, or itself be raised with the word, while manipulative counter-action goes barren.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root heard in punishment appears as the sweetness of fresh, easily swallowed water, set against salty burning water. This reversal lets severe punishment be heard, secondarily, as loss or inversion of nourishing access rather than pain alone.

activation_trace.role: Supplies explicit non-equivalence as the frame for two materially different waters.
Activates fresh sweetness at the punishment root, creating the central reversal.
Intensifies the fresh-water pole as abundant palatability.
Supplies unobstructed passage into the body as the access that punishment may negate.
Supplies actual intake and nourishment rather than abstract pleasantness.
Supplies salinity as the contrary water condition.
Supplies bitter salt water as the material counter-pole to fresh access.

structural_cues: The identical QAC root occurs in 35:7 and 35:12, while 35:12 explicitly denies equality between the two waters yet lets both yield usable goods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a root reversal from punishment to fresh water and a contrast of intake conditions; I infer deprivation or inversion as one felt dimension of punishment. Alternatively, the two senses may remain only a branch echo with no causal claim.

changed_reading.before: The severe punishment is heard only as externally inflicted pain.
changed_reading.after: It can also be heard as severe cutoff from what passes, refreshes, and sustains, with bitterness replacing accessible sweetness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invoked partners cannot hear or answer, and later disavow the partnership. Kufr therefore carries a relational reversal: those who sever truth in 35:7 enter an attachment that eventually severs itself from them.

activation_trace.role: Supplies repeated invocation as the attempted relation with the partners.
Supplies hearing whose negation exposes the relation's non-reciprocity.
Supplies responsive answer whose absence deepens the failed attachment.
Activates repudiation and disengagement as the relation's eventual reversal.
Supplies partnership as the bond that is repudiated.

structural_cues: The subject of yakfuruna in 35:14 is the invoked plurality, so the focus root returns with the apparent deniers now positioned as objects of disavowal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed invocation and later repudiation of partnership; I infer a rebound from the focus agents' truth-severing to their partners' severing from them. Alternatively, the changed subject may create irony without redefining kafaru in 35:7.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is only a doctrinal property possessed by the punished group.
changed_reading.after: Kufr is also a failed relation that reverses: the attachment chosen through denial ultimately disowns those who relied on it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A burden cannot be transferred even through a close relation, while purification returns to the acting self and each trajectory reaches its own destination. The repeated lahum in 35:7 thus allocates outcome personally rather than merely assigning group reputation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a heavy liability carried by its own bearer.
Supplies active loading that makes attempted transfer concrete.
Supplies bearing a moral burden, whose transfer the clause blocks.
Supplies self-purification as the positive counterpart to burden.
Supplies the self as the direct beneficiary of its purification.
Supplies arrival at an eventual end, closing the personal trajectory.

structural_cues: Repeated negatives in 35:18 block transfer even to kin, while reflexive and possessive forms return purification to the same self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nontransferable burden, reflexive purification, and destination; I infer that the paired lahum clauses in 35:7 mark personally accruing trajectories. Alternatively, social conditions and collective calls can still shape what each person does.

changed_reading.before: The plural classes receive collective verdicts that may blur individual action.
changed_reading.after: Each person's denial, trust, repair, liability, and purification accrue to that self, even while people travel in socially formed groups.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus polarity is recast through a chain of unequal capacities and environments: blindness and sight, darkness and light, exposed heat and shelter, death and life, unresponsive burial and hearing. Iman and salih action can thus be read as receptive vitality, not labels alone.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the repeated denial of equivalence that carries the focus polarity forward.
Supplies loss of visual capacity as one embodied negative pole.
Supplies inward discernment as the positive capacity behind mere sight.
Supplies illumination as the environment in which discernment can operate.
Supplies shelter and protection as the habitable pole.
Supplies exposed heat as the contrary environment.
Supplies living responsiveness as a capacity rather than a static category.
Supplies loss of force and life as its opposite.
Supplies understanding and responsive compliance as the decisive hearing capacity.
Supplies burial as the image of unresponsiveness that ordinary address cannot overcome.

structural_cues: 35:19-22 repeats wa-la and ma yastawi across four paired contrasts, then shifts from comparison to God's making whom he wills hear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered analogy of capacities and environments; I map it back to the focus classes as a developmental reading of receptivity. Alternatively, the pairs may assert unequal ends without implying that one capacity grows into another.

changed_reading.before: Belief and denial are abstract positions followed by external awards.
changed_reading.after: They are also embodied modes of receptivity: one can see, inhabit shelter, live, and hear, while the other is progressively closed to those capacities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wage and trade imagery is explicitly non-peer: humans are needy, God is self-sufficient, the trade does not perish, wages are paid in full, and favor adds surplus while forgiveness and appreciation remain active. Ajr kabir is therefore fulfillment plus overflow, not a bargain from which God benefits.

activation_trace.role: Supplies human need as one side of the radically unequal exchange.
Supplies divine self-sufficiency, excluding a peer bargain that enriches the giver.
Supplies profit-seeking trade as the explicit economic analogy.
Supplies ruin whose negation guarantees that this trade does not collapse.
Supplies complete payment without shortage.
Repeats the focus wage as what is fully settled.
Supplies increase beyond complete settlement.
Supplies freely given beneficence as the source of the surplus.
Repeats protective pardon alongside full pay and surplus.
Supplies recognition of good received, unexpectedly attributed to the non-needy giver.

structural_cues: 35:29-30 moves from practices financed by prior provision to unperishing trade, full wages, then an added increase from favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal need, trade, full payment, increase, gift, pardon, and appreciation; I infer an economy of fulfilled obligation plus gratuitous surplus. Alternatively, the commercial language may function only as encouragement rather than a precise account structure.

changed_reading.before: The great reward is proportional pay exchanged between two interested parties.
changed_reading.after: The non-needy giver fully settles the work's return, protects against deficit, then adds unowed surplus and recognition; greatness exceeds equivalence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The selected inheritors of the book are internally graded as self-wronging, moderate, and preceding in goods, yet the sequence closes with great favor. The focus binary can mark ultimate directional poles without exhausting every present moral state inside the believing inheritance community.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inherited knowledge or book as the shared positive field containing the subgroups.
Supplies selection, making the later internal variation especially consequential.
Supplies misplacement as the self-directed failure within the selected group.
Supplies moderation between extremes as a middle trajectory.
Supplies forward precedence as the most active trajectory.
Supplies beneficial good as what the forerunner moves toward.
Supplies gift as the encompassing result of the graded field.
Repeats the focus magnitude adjective, now attached to favor rather than wage.

structural_cues: Three coordinated fa-minhum clauses divide those previously selected from among the servants, not three unrelated populations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one selected inheritance community with three moral speeds and one great favor; I infer that 35:7's polarity is directional rather than an exhaustive snapshot taxonomy. Alternatively, 35:32's groups may not map directly onto those who amanu in 35:7.

changed_reading.before: 35:7 divides every person into two internally uniform and immediately exhaustive groups.
changed_reading.after: Its two directions remain real, but the positive field can contain self-wronging, moderation, and precedence, leaving forgiveness structurally important within belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive destination removes grief and excludes fatigue, while the negative destination never reaches termination or lightening. Its occupants ask to exit and perform salih work, but the lifespan in which such work could operate has already been spent. The outcomes are opposite temporal regimes, not momentary payments.

activation_trace.role: Supplies departure as the removal of grief from the positive destination.
Supplies inward roughness and grief as what no longer remains.
Supplies exhausting labor whose touch is excluded from the settled dwelling.
Supplies weakness and fatigue as a second excluded recurrence.
Repeats truth-blocking at both the class label and the generalized closing label.
Supplies completion or ending, whose negation makes the punitive state nonterminating.
Supplies lightening, also negated so intensity does not decay.
Repeats punitive pain inside the no-ending and no-lightening structure.
Supplies the requested exit from the closed temporal regime.
Repeats intentional work as what the occupants belatedly promise.
Repeats genuine repair as the lost opportunity they name.
Supplies extended lifetime as the bounded interval in which repair was possible.

structural_cues: 35:34-37 alternates permanent removals on the positive side with repeated negatives on the punitive side, then quotes a failed request to return to action-time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies removed grief, absent fatigue, nontermination, nonlightening, and a belated request for salih work; I infer two durable temporal regimes generated by how action-time was used. Alternatively, the descriptions may specify only final destinations, not present trajectories.

changed_reading.before: Punishment and reward are discrete future events added after the two kinds of conduct.
changed_reading.after: They become opposite durations: settled life with recurring harm removed versus an unrelieved state from which the past opportunity for reparative work cannot be recovered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inner source from which acts issue is known, and repeated kufr falls back upon its actor while increasing only abhorrence and loss. The focus verdict can therefore describe a recursive present process as well as a later sentence.

activation_trace.role: Supplies disclosed knowledge of what is otherwise inwardly hidden.
Supplies the inward origin from which outward acts proceed.
Repeats covering as both act and burden falling upon the same actor.
Supplies repeated growth, turning denial into a compounding process.
Supplies severe abhorrence as one accumulating result.
Supplies commercial loss as the other accumulating result, reversing the profitable wage model.

structural_cues: 35:39 repeats kufr six times around fa-alayhi and two parallel wa-la yazidu clauses, grammatically returning and compounding the act upon its bearer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inward source, self-return, repeated increase, abhorrence, and loss; I infer a feedback loop in which covering degrades its own actor. Alternatively, the increase may name divine evaluation only, without a psychological recursion.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is a fixed status followed later by an externally assigned punishment.
changed_reading.after: Kufr recursively returns to and diminishes its bearer, so severe punishment can include the present compounding of aversion and loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic holding prevents collapse, and forbearance sits beside forgiveness; later, immediate seizure for what people acquire would leave no creature, but judgment is delayed to a term. Maghfirah can therefore be heard as active restraint that preserves action-space, not only retrospective erasure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies active holding that prevents a system from being released into collapse.
Supplies displacement from state or place as the collapse being restrained.
Supplies patient self-restraint beside the repeated forgiveness term.
Repeats protective pardon in the immediate setting of restraint and held collapse.
Supplies seizure for fault as the consequence that is not immediately executed.
Supplies acquired result as the human basis for accountability.
Supplies leaving in place, whose negation measures the scope of immediate seizure.
Supplies postponement as the enacted form of restraint.
Supplies a bounded term that gives postponement its temporal structure.

structural_cues: 35:41 pairs held non-collapse with forbearing forgiveness; 35:45 closes the surah by contrasting universal immediate seizure with postponement to an appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies holding, prevented displacement, forbearance, pardon, possible seizure, and delay; I infer a structural analogy in which forgiveness actively suspends deserved collapse. Alternatively, cosmic holding and judicial pardon may be adjacent attributes rather than one causal model.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is an after-the-fact deletion granted only once judgment arrives.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness may already operate as patient holding and delay, preserving a finite interval in which persons and worlds remain able to act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning increases aversion; arrogance drives harmful plotting; the harm then surrounds its own people according to a recurring, unaltered path. Past peoples with greater concentrated force still could not escape. Severe punishment is thus the recoil and enclosure of a pattern, not victory in a contest of comparable powers.

activation_trace.role: Supplies growth as warning paradoxically intensifies the negative response.
Supplies recoiling distance as the response that grows.
Activates self-exalting greatness as the posture feeding the plot.
Supplies descending harm that surrounds rather than merely strikes from outside.
Supplies the plot's own affiliated people as those enclosed by its recoil.
Supplies a repeatedly traveled pattern that links this recoil to prior cases.
Supplies the end-state or sequel that travel is meant to inspect.
Repeats severity as a property previously possessed by stronger peoples.
Supplies force concentrated like strands, yet shown unable to secure escape.
Supplies evasion from pursuit, whose negation closes the imagined power contest.

structural_cues: 35:42-44 orders increased aversion, arrogant plotting, the plot's enclosure of its people, an unchanged pattern, and the failure of historically stronger groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recoil, enclosure, recurrence, historical sequel, superior human force, and failed evasion; I infer that punishment realizes the plot's own patterned direction. Alternatively, the judgment can still be read primarily as an external sanction imposed after the recoil.

changed_reading.before: Severe punishment means an external force overpowering a weaker opposing force.
changed_reading.after: Severity includes an inescapable recoil: arrogant misdirection grows, encloses its own affiliates, and reaches the same sequel even when its human power is greater.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the agricultural branch of k-f-r against the ordinary denial sense in 35:7. It remains anchored in kafaru and is reinforced by the later dead-land and fruit sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as an ecological analogy, never as a lexical replacement or an exculpation of denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kafaru at word 2, heard through covering seed, with the focus outcome clauses read beside later revival and fruit emergence.

activation_trace.role: Supplies seed-covering as a branch-distant material image of hidden potential.
Supplies land revived by water as the process that tests what was hidden.
Supplies dried growth reopened by rain as emergence after latency.
Supplies delivered water as the enabling input for disclosure.
Supplies resulting benefit as the eventual evidence of what the covering contained.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is immediately legible as a barren concealment whose result is already visible.
changed_reading.after: The seed-cover branch makes concealment temporally ambiguous at first: what is buried is disclosed by what later emerges, so the outcome clauses can be heard as a test of trajectories by their fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the technical fracture sense of ajr rather than ordinary recompense. It remains anchored in ajr beside salih repair and protective pardon, but downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for repaired damage, not an etymological definition of reward.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence salihat, maghfirah, and ajr at words 9, 11, and 12 permits repair, protection, and mending to form one material model.

activation_trace.role: Supplies restoration against corruption as the work performed.
Supplies protection from the continuing effect of prior fault.
Supplies a fracture mended with residual irregularity as an image of recompensed repair.

changed_reading.before: Reward is a pristine bonus unrelated to the damaged history that preceded it.
changed_reading.after: Reward can be imaged as compensated mending: damage is repaired and protected without requiring the repaired history to have been frictionless or unscarred.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial model is surprising because it uses branch-distant physical senses of adhab and ajr. It remains anchored in the exact outcome roots and the intervening protective-cover root, but downstream prose should render it only as an architectural mnemonic, not as translation or doctrinal spatial description.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opposed outcomes adhab shadid and maghfirah wa-ajr kabir at words 4-5 and 11-13 form a sequence of exposure, cover, and enlarged surface.

activation_trace.role: Supplies unshielded exposure beneath the sky as the negative surface.
Supplies binding that makes the exposure a severe constraint rather than freedom.
Supplies the protective covering that reverses unshielded exposure.
Supplies an unenclosed roof surface as a branch-distant image of the positive return.
Supplies broad scale to the open positive surface.

changed_reading.before: The two outcome clauses name abstract destinations without material organization.
changed_reading.after: They can be held as three surfaces: constrained unshielding, preserving cover, and a broad elevated return open beyond enclosure.

strongest_changes: 35:8 separates a deed's attractive appearance from its actual salih quality, making self-perception an unreliable moral test.
35:10 turns faith, good speech, and salih work into a live lift mechanism while preserving ambiguity over what raises what.
35:29-30 expands ajr kabir from proportional pay into full settlement, pardon, gratuitous surplus, and recognition from a non-needy giver.
35:32 prevents the focus binary from becoming an exhaustive snapshot taxonomy by placing three moral trajectories inside one selected inheritance community.
35:36-45 recast the outcomes as durable temporal and feedback regimes: no-release punishment, recursive loss, patterned recoil, and forgiving delay that preserves action-time.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse repeatedly changed when context activated material reversals inside its roots: suppressive cover versus protective cover, punishment versus fresh sweetness, tightening versus enlargement, barren plotting versus lifted repair, and seizure versus active restraint. These activations support several coexisting readings rather than one resolved interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The subject and object relation of yarfa'uhu in 35:10 remains live, so work may raise speech, God may raise work, or the two may be mutually implicated.
The three groups in 35:32 complicate the binary, but their exact relation to alladhina amanu in 35:7 is not explicit.
The fresh-water, seed-cover, fracture, and architectural activations may be productive branch echoes without being intended lexical senses in 35:7.
The trace leaves open how much of adhab and ajr is already immanent in present feedback and how much is reserved for final judgment.

baseline.text: İnkâr edenler için ağır bir azap vardır. İnanıp iyi işler yapanlar için ise bağışlanma ve büyük bir ödül vardır.

findings.text: İnkârın gerçeği örten perdesi ile bağışlamanın kişiyi sonuçtan koruyan örtüsü, örtmenin birbirine zıt iki işlevini gösterir.
İyi işin ödülü, keyfî bir armağandan çok, üretken emeğin ödenmesi gereken ve boşa çıkmayan karşılığı olarak belirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A surface controls how an entity appears, what it exposes, and what it protects.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Appearance is grounded in craft and material layers: cosmetic display, armor, veil, hairy hide, leather container, and the stripping of flesh from bone.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cover, veil, and armor
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A layer is placed over a vulnerable body or object to conceal, preserve, or defend it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: protective covering (quranic:root_001096:B001/m01); covering over object or weapon (quranic:root_001307:B001/m01); bodily garment (quranic:root_001341:B001/m01); armor worn for defense (quranic:root_001341:B002/m01); tent-like fine screen (quranic:root_001315:B006/m01); garment or shield (quranic:root_000273:B005/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Moral covering, ordinary dress, and martial defense share the operation of interposing a layer. The channel gives forgiveness and concealment a concrete protective geometry without collapsing them into the same surface reading.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Value remains productive when goods, payment, and assigned shares circulate; blockage turns circulation into stagnation and loss.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The moral economy is rendered through a literal marketplace with pricing, sale, circulation, wage, and market stagnation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wage, assigned share, and continuing yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Work generates an agreed payment, provision is apportioned, and a continuing grant returns benefit to its recipient.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wage or recompense for work (quranic:root_000015:B001/m01); fee fixed for a task (quranic:root_000248:B005/m01); apportioned provision (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01); worker's wage or ration (quranic:root_001046:B004/m01); continuing grant or provision (quranic:root_000240:B006/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reward is a structured return on action: a task, a fixed fee, an apportioned share, and a continuing flow. The channel keeps payment distinct from botanical yield while preserving their common productive-return invariant.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi örtme ve görünmez kılma çekirdeğini; zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme, külün toprakla kapanması ve yıldızların güneş ışığında görünmemesi gibi gerçekleşmelerle açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel örtmedir; dinî inkâr, nimeti yadsıma ve günahı giderme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın örtme çekirdeğini korur; zırh, silah, kül ve gök cisimleriyle ilgili kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyle örterek görünmesini engellemek veya kapalı duruma getirmektir. Zırhın giysiyle, kişinin silahla ya da külün savrulan toprakla örtülmesi bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatarak onu görünmez veya örtülü duruma getirme işlemi.
Zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme ve külün üstünün toprakla kapanması çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Güneşin yıldızları görünmez kılması da görsel örtme sonucu üzerinden bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ve kapatma çekirdeğinde birleşir; farklı örnekler bu işlemin nesne, giysi, silah, kül ve gök görünümü üzerindeki gerçekleşmelerini gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin üstünü başka bir şeyle kapatıp görünmesini engelleyen genel çekirdek için uygundur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dinî reddetme çekirdeği korunur; kalben bilip söylememe, bilip kabul etmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille reddetme yapıya bağlı türlerdir.

concept_map.definition: İnancı, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddederek dinî gerçeği örtmek ya da kabul etmemektir. Kaynaklar bunu inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük, ortak koşma ve yalanlama gibi türlere ayırır.

facets.statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.
Kalben bilip sözle kabul etmeme, bilip boyun eğmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille inkâr etme farklı türlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalı inancın karşıtı sayar ve gerçeği örtme düşüncesiyle açıklar; toplu aktarım çeşitli inkâr, direnme ve ikiyüzlülük biçimlerini de sıralar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnancın karşıtı olan çekirdeği ve reddedilen dinî içeriği birlikte ifade eder.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî gerçeği kabul etmeme çekirdeğini ve inanç karşıtlığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dalın genel dinî karşıtlık bağlamında eylem olarak çevrilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnancı kabul etmeme ve ona karşı durma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bile bile yadsıma veya direnme türünün açıklandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi ile dışa vurulan ret arasındaki ayrımı korur.
error_profile.loses: İkiyüzlülük ve bütünüyle bilgisiz inkâr gibi öteki türleri dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nimeti yadsımayı, onu örtmeyi ve gereği olan şükrü yerine getirmemeyi aynı çekirdekte birleştirir; dalın geçici çerçevesi bu koşulu doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nesne özellikle nimettir ve belirleyici sonuç şükrün terkidir; genel dinî ret bu dala kendiliğinden girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Nimeti yadsıma çekirdeği yalın ve türemiş kullanımlarda korunur; nimetle kurulan yapı ve aşırılık bildiren kişi nitelemesi ayrı gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nimeti tanımamak, değerini örtmek veya onun gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemektir. Bu tutumda aşırı olan kişi de aynı anlam alanında nitelenir.

facets.statement: Bir nimeti yadsıma veya şükrünü yerine getirmeyerek değerini örtme.
Nimetleri sürekli ve aşırı biçimde yadsıyan kişi bu tutumun yoğunlaşmış taşıyıcısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nimeti yadsımayı şükrün karşıtı sayar; örtme açıklaması, nimetin gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemeyi bu karşıtlığın belirleyici davranışı yapar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nimeti tanımama ile ona şükretmeme çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Nimetin inkâr edilmesini ve şükrün terk edilmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nimetin veya yapılan iyiliğin tanınmadığı gündelik bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılan iyiliği tanımama ve karşılığında şükretmeme tutumunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: nimeti yadsımak ve şükrünü yerine getirmemek
iyilikleri karşılıksız ve teşekkürsüz kalan cömert adam

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözün bir şeyden uzak olduğunu bildirme, onunla bağını reddetme ve ondan sıyrılma anlamında kullanılabildiğini açıkça söyler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir inancı yadsımak değil, belirli bir şeyle bağı reddedip ondan uzaklaşmaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca bir şeyden uzaklaşmayı bildiren bağlı yapıda korunur; yalın köke genel bir ayrılma anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyle olan bağı reddetmek, ondan uzak olduğunu açıklamak ve sorumluluk ya da aidiyet bağından sıyrılmaktır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, görüş, eylem veya sorumlulukla ilişkiyi açıkça reddeden bağlı kullanım için uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yapısal olarak bağlı ve dar bir ilişki reddidir; komşu dal genel uzaklık, arınmışlık ve sorumsuzluk bildirimlerini de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel bağ kesme ve uzak durma dalı en yakın anlam sınırını verdiği için yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Eylem kişinin kendi reddi değil, başka bir kişinin durumu hakkında adlandırma veya hüküm vermedir.
